defects.problem: The opening is correctly said to contain a horn, but immediately said to contain no brass. A horn is a brass instrument.
defects.evidence: https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/6/65/IMSLP20582-PMLP47886-Mahler_-_Das_Lied_von_der_Erde_(orch._score).pdf — printed p.61, horn staff in the opening.
defects.fix: Replace ‘with no brass, harps or percussion yet’ with ‘with no other brass, harps or percussion yet’.

defects.problem: The return at Tempo I subito (Andante) is described as having two flats, but the score returns to a one-sharp G-major signature, consistent with the page’s metadata and audio corroboration.
defects.evidence: https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/6/65/IMSLP20582-PMLP47886-Mahler_-_Das_Lied_von_der_Erde_(orch._score).pdf — printed p.77, rehearsal16 and following system.
defects.fix: Replace ‘two flats softened to a sweeter key’ with ‘the return to G major’ (or another accurate, score-grounded description).

defects.problem: Detected onset density is converted into ‘the pulse’ and ‘one or two notes a second’. The analysis measures detected attacks, not note count or musical pulse; overlapping instrumental notes make those distinct quantities.
defects.evidence: cache/analysis/mahler-das-lied-schoenheit.txt:26,90-94 — column is onsets/s, falling to1.4 and1.0; the tempo estimate is explicitly unreliable.
defects.fix: Describe the thinning activity/texture, or explicitly say ‘the report detects only one or two attacks a second’. Do not identify this with the beat or exact note count. Retitle the join ‘Ganz ruhig: the texture thins’ or similar.

defects.problem: Bethge’s Von der Schönheit is called a rhymed poem, but the reproduced German version is unrhymed free verse.
defects.fix: Replace ‘Bethge’s rhymed poem’ with ‘Bethge’s German paraphrase’.
